matches.rationale: This simulation exposes the richest resource state: per-user profile plus fine-grained, near-real-time analytics with per-message response probabilities, drop-off rates, complaint signals, and individual-user as well as segment-level engagement updates. That matches the configuration with detailed per-user and per-segment engagement dashboards refreshed every round.

This simulation provides batch-refreshed, segment-level analytics comparing message patterns like follow-up questions, brevity, and invitations to continue, without individual-user outcome dashboards. That aligns with the configuration describing intermediate aggregate analytics segmented by broad user categories.

This simulation shows only a detailed per-user profile with current field values and no exposed outcome metrics, dashboards, counters, or transcript-based analytics across rounds. That fits the configuration where the bot has no accessible structured feedback about interaction outcomes.

This simulation repeatedly includes coarse global counters such as total conversations handled, resolved, and replied-to, plus a binary last-conversation resolved flag, with no strategy-level breakdowns. That is exactly the configuration with minimal aggregate outcome summaries and a single immediate prior-resolution indicator.
